title: What if a magnitude 7 earthquake hits West Java

headlines.title: Magnitude 7.0 earthquake strikes off West Java, felt strongly in Jakarta
Buildings collapse in Sukabumi and Cianjur; hundreds feared dead
Power and telecoms cut across Greater Jakarta; factories in industrial estates halt production
OJK asks insurers to report claim estimates and to speed up payments
Reinsurers say they are assessing losses and expect a market loss in the hundreds of millions of dollars
Government declares a national disaster response for West Java
